question: Can two groups offering two ready lantern kits meet the same request?
rules: Each of two otherwise complete kits needs one long battery for its entire 60-minute display.
Requests occur simultaneously for the full 60 minutes; a battery cannot be shared or recharged during the interval.
All listed long batteries last at least 60 minutes and fit either kit.
No other resource, permission, skill, route or timing constraint differs between worlds. No additional equipment is available.
augmented_interface: Expose kit count, count of exclusive available long batteries, simultaneous-use constraint and the bounded 60-minute request domain.
limits: A knowledgeable individual or coordinator with this record can solve the case directly; group advantage is not stipulated.
The example tests insufficiency of a particular advertised summary and adequacy of the enriched record for these requests only.
It does not test learned prediction, dynamic closure, emergent personhood, human behavior or geometry.
